A two lane rural highway passing through a forested area has sight obstruction located at $1.5\text{ m}$ from the edge of the carriageway on inner side of circular curve of radius $116\text{ m}$ and deflection angle $40^\circ$. The super elevation provided was $7\%$ and lateral friction was $0.15$. A vehicle traveling in horizontal curve of the highway with posted speed of $50\text{ kmph}$ had a crash. Check the designed super elevation and setback distance. Suggest mitigation measures to reduce such crashes in future.

Determine the elevation of the lowest point and at point $5\text{ m}$ left from PVI if the elevation of PVI is $310.12\text{ m}$. Calculate the comfortable speed on the curve using the rate of change of centrifugal acceleration of $0.54\text{ m/s}^3$ and compare this curve with the one required to provide minimum sight distance for the speed under headlight sight distance condition. What will be the effect on above result if the traffic is one way?

Calculate the comfortable speed on the curve using a rate of change of centrifugal acceleration of $0.6\text{ m/s}^3 , and$ design the curve length required to satisfy the headlight sight distance conditions. Assume the height of the headlight beam to be $0.75\text{ m}$ and the vertical dispersion angle of the headlight beam to be $1^\circ$. Determine the elevation of the lowest point on the curve and the elevation at a point $10\text{ m}$ to the left of the PVI, given that the elevation of the PVI is $120\text{ m}$.

Calculate the length of transition curve and shift, if the design speed is $80\text{ kmph}$. The radius of circular curve is $250\text{ m}$. An allowable rate of change of centrifugal acceleration is $70\text{ cm/s}^3$. Allowable rate of change of superelevation is $1\text{ in } 120$. The width of the pavement is $7.00\text{ m}$. Assume rotation of pavement about the inner edge.

If the design speed of the road is $100\text{ kmph}$ and radius of the circular section is $250\text{ m} , determine$ the length of the transition curve for comfort and for introducing super-elevation at $1\text{ in }100$. The length of the wheel base of the design vehicle is $6\text{ m}$.

Examine whether the crash could be attributed to $a^n$ incorrect posted speed limit. If a deficiency exists in the posted speed sign, determine the appropriate speed limit that should be displayed.
